name: AnyDB
description:
AnyDB is a workspace for records, documents, files, and business processes. This connector links Claude to your AnyDB account so you can find, create, update, copy, and move records, search their content by meaning, and upload or download files without leaving the conversation.

You can also build and adjust AnyDB solutions: define record types with fields, layouts, and formulas; set up filtered views and reports; share records and forms; add comments; review and restore earlier record versions; and automate work with event-driven workflows.

Sign in with your AnyDB account. The connector can only see and change what your AnyDB permissions allow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AnyDB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AnyDB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.anydb.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AnyDB MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AnyDB lists 67 MCP tools, including anydb_add_comment, anydb_check_permissions, anydb_create_docgen_template, anydb_create_report, anydb_create_share, anydb_create_type, anydb_create_view, anydb_create_workflow, anydb_create_workspace, anydb_delete_docgen_template, anydb_delete_view, and anydb_discover_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AnyDB?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AnyDB in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AnyDB requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AnyDB is developed by Humanly Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
